name: DS Automobiles
verdict: DS Automobiles is a Stellantis marque; Stellantis is a listed company with no controlling shareholder.
note: French Stellantis marque; title partner of DS Penske in Formula E (2025/26) and of the France SailGP team. Stellantis's largest shareholders are Etablissements Peugeot Frères (7.72%) and the French state investment bank Bpifrance Participations (6.64%) (see stellantis-nv-record); France has no sourced record of serious abuses in this dataset, so no tier.
